headline: Raleigh's 3 homers lift Mariners past Phillies, 9-2
recap: The Phillies fell 9-2 at Seattle on Monday, with the game decided early after the Mariners scored five runs in the bottom of the first. Zack Wheeler took the loss, allowing eight earned runs on nine hits over four innings. Cal Raleigh went 3-for-3 with three home runs and four RBI for Seattle, and Julio Rodriguez added a two-run homer among his three RBI. Logan Gilbert got the win, allowing two runs over five innings. J.T. Realmuto homered and drove in a run for Philadelphia, and Alec Bohm added an RBI; Bryce Harper went 2-for-3 with a walk.
The loss snapped the Phillies' nine-game winning streak. Philadelphia is 73-59, in second place in the NL East, 3.5 games behind the first-place Atlanta Braves.

The Phillies and Mariners play game two of their three-game series Tuesday at T-Mobile Park, with first pitch at 9:40 PM ET. Aaron Nola starts for Philadelphia opposite Mariners right-hander George Kirby. Philadelphia is a -108 moneyline favorite, with Seattle at -112.
